ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- if (payload is String) read(payload, "application/json") else payload

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- (correlationId default uuid()) as String

logger.doc:name: Log Message Receipt
Log Successful Acknowledgment
Log Validation Error
logger.message: #[write({ event: "CONTACT_VALIDATION_FAILED", correlationId: vars.messageCorrelationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", description: error.description default "Validation failed", disposition: "REJECTED_TO_DLQ" }, "application/json")]

logger.doc:name: Log Database Connectivity Error
logger.message: #[write({ event: "CONTACT_DATABASE_CONNECTIVITY_FAILED", correlationId: vars.messageCorrelationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", description: error.description default "Database connectivity failed", disposition: "REQUEUED" }, "application/json")]

logger.doc:name: Log Retry Exhausted Error
logger.message: #[write({ event: "CONTACT_DATABASE_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED", correlationId: vars.messageCorrelationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", description: error.description default "Database retries exhausted", disposition: "REQUEUED" }, "application/json")]

logger.doc:name: Log Connectivity Error
logger.message: #[write({ event: "CONTACT_CONNECTIVITY_FAILED", correlationId: vars.messageCorrelationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", description: error.description default "Connectivity failure", disposition: "REQUEUED" }, "application/json")]

logger.doc:name: Log Expression Error
logger.message: #[write({ event: "CONTACT_EXPRESSION_ERROR", correlationId: vars.messageCorrelationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", description: error.description default "Expression failure", disposition: "NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED" }, "application/json")]

logger.doc:name: Log Unexpected Error
logger.message: #[write({ event: "CONTACT_UNEXPECTED_ERROR", correlationId: vars.messageCorrelationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", description: error.description default "Unexpected failure", disposition: "NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED" }, "application/json")]
